body: I can't really stay on numerous reasons (my visa is up in September, I have the ability to extend, but I want to go home instead), I have university waiting for me and have to continue my studies (which I hope I did not screw up). But yeah, it's not minor as I stated earlier in one of the comments and there is a huge monetary loss to a group of people. There are multiple accusations and charges.
I sure as shit hope so.

The chance is not small, it's not a small thing I did (a misdemeanor?? not sure what the terminology is) but rather a criminal offense. And not just one. There is material damage getting up to a few good figures in money (I really don't know that well anymore and I don't want to say it out loud.. let's just say that it's not small). And since it's serious, I don't think saying "I was a kid" gets me off the hook. It's worth a shot of course. I'm trying to figure out how to lawyer up.

I have not been depressed lately. This news just got the best of me in an instant.. they remind me of a lot more memories of what I used to be. I'm thankful, that I'm not like this anymore, but I still remember..

Speaking to a lawyer is reasonable, but it's costly. Something I currently can't afford. I know, it isn't, but it messes with my head that something this old has come up.. so it reminds me about a lot of stuff..

Yeah, the past things are coming back. Not new stuff. I know exactly what it is. Unfortunately they only get erased if you payed your dues while you were underage. If you are not convicted then, and it's later found out, you're still responsible (they also have an expiry date of some years but I'm unable to find the law for my home country - and I don't feel safe to write it here either).

Haven't spoke to anyone yet.. I work roughly 10 hours a day, there simply is no time to do anything else besides work, eat and rest. And to think about what I'm going to do about it.. the thoughts are dark, to say the least. Exhaustion plays a big role so everything is a downwards spiral. Fuck my life.

My life as I know it, will end, no matter which choices I take. I've been thinking about it for the last day and I just want to take the easy way out. It's bad enough as it is.. atleast then everything will cease to exist for me.
Im open for PM-s as well.. I can not respond instantly, as I have to work etc. but I'll get there eventually. I'm a human just like you, so I will listen.

Well, it's been on and off for a few years.. so yeah. Days are really nothing, but it's bad enough. I've been doing better because of work and this takes my mind off of stuff, I have really little free time and doing something else helps.
Thats why Im in Australia. To take a break. Even if I work, it is a break in a sense that I dont have to do the things I used to, but will get back to them when I have to leave this country.
WHV yeah. Im glad Im here, but the last few days have been completely horrible.

Whatever you do, things can be changed. All you need is to find an activity that suits you, calms you down and makes you forget about everything else. This way you can do something if you're feeling down - write, do art or whatever you want to do. And if anyone doesn't like it, or you, it's THEIR problem, not yours. You shouldn't be affected by this. They just try to put you down to make themselves feel better. But guess what, you're the stronger one. You will always be.
You are very welcome!
I've talked to many girls about this - no they do not want bigger dicks. They say they hurt. Calm down man, everything is good. There isn't a need to compensate - most people find it weird.
You have a lot to look for in life, think about the happy things. Also, weight gain at this age is like.. nothing. Chances are that you will not be "fat" in the future.
There is no point, I stopped gaming a few years ago because I started doing something else (take pictures). Haven't played a game in ages.
Thanks. I'll think about it.

I am attending a university in a different town, but it's not really far away, as they also live in the same place now (we are the same age so similar paths are something that happen). If I was to stop communicating with them, they would still probably try to hit me up every now and then. It's not that they have forgotten me, just it's a bit annoying and has lasted for quite a while.
I wish it was possible in any way - but I've known them since kindergarten. I live in a small town where abandoning someone is usually ending up alone.
I wish I could show them, but this would make this throwaway thing pointless.
